pages.text: Chase affixed drops: mob and boss weapons and armor that roll random modifiers. $(thing)IridescentCraft$() adds $(bold)88 custom affix entries$() to Apotheosis's built-in pool, 5 of them End-themed and found only in End dimension loot.$(br2)Affixes also bring $(bold)gem sockets$(), more at higher rarity: see $(l:icraft:loot/gems)Apotheosis Gems$(/l).

pages.title: Affix Tiers
pages.text: $(bold)Common$() ($(t1)Tier 1$()+): mild bonuses, 0-1 sockets.$(br)$(bold)Uncommon$() ($(t2)Tier 2$()+): moderate bonuses, 1-2 sockets.$(br)$(bold)Rare$() ($(t2)Tier 2$()+): strong bonuses, 2 sockets.$(br)$(bold)Epic$() ($(t3)Tier 3$()+): very strong bonuses, 2-3 sockets.$(br)$(bold)Legendary$() ($(t4)Tier 4$()): exceptional bonuses, 3-4 sockets.$(br)$(bold)Mythic$() (post-endgame, Rift infusion only): maximum bonuses, 4 sockets.

pages.title: Reforging
pages.text: The $(thing)Apotheosis$() Reforging Station rerolls an item's affixes. $(thing)IridescentCraft$() adds three reforge tokens, each with a minimum affix quality:$(br)$(bold)Basic Reforging Token$(): Uncommon$(br)$(bold)Advanced Reforging Token$(): Rare$(br)$(bold)Ultimate Reforging Token$(): Epic$(br2)Craft them from boss materials at the reforging stations. They are not $(l:icraft:loot/token_system)Progression Tokens$(/l).

pages.title: End-Themed Affixes
pages.text: End loot can roll $(bold)5 exclusive affixes$(). They work off the End's own mechanics (Void Proximity damage scaling, Ender Displacement teleportation, Void Corruption) and rank among the strongest in the game.$(br2)This gear pairs well with the $(bold)Voidward$() and $(bold)Warp Shield$() enchantments for End survival.$(br2)$(bold)Next: socket your best drop ($(l:icraft:loot/gems)Gems$(/l)).$()
